args.body: Take GHOST-DIAGNOSTIC-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW in an eligible independent provider turn. The changed fact is a completed downloadable diagnostic candidate, not a reproduced upstream defect. Verify the actual harness and documented commands rather than relying on 27 producer checks. Stop release on concrete defects; do not edit or deploy. Missing installed dependency limits upstream execution only. Demand remains unknown with three unclassified sources; payment acceptance remains a separate dependency. Preserve all live experiment windows and mandatory retirements.

description: The Ghost diagnostic now has a reviewable public package with 27/27 producer checks; upstream conversion and real Ghost imports remain untested. Delegate independent verification before publication. Funding remains unverified, revenue is zero, and three unclassified feedback sources leave demand unknown.
